definition.name: Orison · flexible service
definition.description: Tern brings fuel to Meridian, waits aboard, and returns when the orbits line up.
definition.provenance: Coupled finite-force plans with passive docked mass and paid capture. Funded station top-ups, flexible windows and relay dwell; bounded rolling history.
